original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds a new configuration option `frontend.log-query-request-headers` to enable logging of request headers in query logs.

decision.reason: [ev-bae573dad702] lists `frontend.log-query-request-headers` as a new Features entry in 3.0.0: an optional setting that turns on request-header logging. Nothing in it says existing behaviour changes or breaks. The key could not have been set before 3.0.0, so no narrower or shielded environment state exists to express. Every environment upgrading from <3.0.0 gains the option, which the edge-from-version condition captures. This is acceptable because the consequence is only informational.
